headline: Anthropic suspends access to new models, sparking debate on India's AI future and prompting government investigations into AI companies
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by regulatory concerns and technological advancements. Anthropic has suspended access to its new models, prompting debate in India about the country's AI ambitions. Meanwhile, OpenAI is facing an investigation from state attorneys general, and Amazon's CEO reportedly raised concerns about Anthropic's models before the government crackdown. On the technological front, researchers are exploring new systems to improve the accuracy of RAG systems, and companies like AWS and HashiCorp are introducing new features to enhance the reliability and productivity of their AI and infrastructure offerings.

research.title: Larger Context Windows Don’t Fix RAG — So I Built a System That Does
research.summary: Increasing context size in RAG systems doesn’t improve accuracy for aggregation tasks—it makes errors harder to detect. The author built a deterministic full-scan engine to improve accuracy.
research.why_it_matters: This research matters because it highlights the limitations of current RAG systems and proposes a new approach to improve their accuracy, which could have significant implications for the development of more reliable AI models.

research.title: Parse PDFs for RAG Locally with Docling: Rich Tables, No Cloud Upload
research.summary: The author introduces Docling, a system that allows users to parse PDFs for RAG locally, without uploading them to the cloud, and extracts rich tables, OCR, captions, and headings.
research.why_it_matters: This research matters because it provides a solution for users who need to parse PDFs for RAG without relying on cloud services, which could improve data privacy and security.

features_updates.title: AWS Introduces Durable Storage Option for ElastiCache for Valkey
features_updates.summary: AWS has introduced durability for Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey, enabling reliable data retention across failures and expanding support beyond caching to persistent workloads.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update matters because it provides users with a more reliable and durable storage option for their ElastiCache for Valkey workloads, which could improve the overall performance and availability of their applications.

features_updates.title: Terraform MCP Server Enables AI Assistants to Interact with Terraform Infrastructure
features_updates.summary: HashiCorp has announced the general availability of the Terraform MCP Server, an open-source MCP server that enables agents to integrate with Terraform Registry APIs.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update matters because it enables AI assistants to interact with Terraform infrastructure, which could improve the productivity of infrastructure teams by automating routine tasks.

industry_business.title: As Anthropic suspends access to new models, India debates its AI future
industry_business.summary: Tech leaders debate whether the Anthropic episode is a wake-up call for India’s AI ambitions.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This news matters because it highlights the regulatory challenges facing AI companies and the potential implications for India's AI development, which could have significant economic and social impacts.

industry_business.title: Amazon CEO reportedly raised Anthropic model concerns before government crackdown
industry_business.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy may have been the source of security concerns that led Anthropic to cut off worldwide access to two models on Friday.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This news matters because it suggests that major tech companies are taking a proactive role in addressing regulatory concerns around AI, which could influence the development of AI policies and guidelines.

policy_society.title: OpenAI faces investigation from state attorneys general
policy_society.summary: It's not clear which states are involved, but they're asking about everything from OpenAI's ad policies to its handling of health data.
policy_society.why_it_matters: This investigation matters because it highlights the growing regulatory scrutiny of AI companies and the need for clearer guidelines and policies around AI development and deployment, which could have significant implications for the future of AI.
